tools.name: check_contractor
tools.description: Look up a US contractor in official public licence, permit, and discipline records (WA, TX, NYC, OR, CT and PA (Pittsburgh city licences only)) and return a match confidence and 0-100 trust score. A name-only match below 0.8 confidence returns verdict needs_review. Requires Authorization: Bearer <ap

tools.name: get_coverage
tools.description: Return jurisdictions, sources, record counts, freshness, pricing, and known limits. Free; no API key required.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "check_contractor" references sensitive artifacts (authorization, bearer). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
